column3: Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew explicitly names Absalom in both opening and later clauses; BSB begins with “He.”
The Hebrew says that there is no one from the king to hear him; BSB supplies the office “deputy.”
The Hebrew explicitly names Absalom; BSB uses “he.”
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed; BSB supplies “Absalom.”
The Hebrew repeats Absalom’s name and uses singular “heart”; BSB uses “he” and plural “hearts.”
The Hebrew says “forty years”; BSB says “four years.”
The Hebrew repeats the vow and vowing root and does not name Hebron in the quoted promise; BSB adds “in Hebron.”
The Hebrew leaves the departing subject unnamed; BSB supplies “Absalom.”
